name: Hamza Ali Mazari
cover_identity: Hamza Ali Mazari — Karachi local, Lyari criminal associate
infiltration_route: India → Afghanistan → Torkham border crossing → Pakistan (classic RAW deep-cover route)
real_life_inspiration: Major Mohit Sharma (Ashok Chakra, posthumous) — RAW operative who infiltrated Lashkar-e-Taiba networks under the alias 'Iftikhar Bhatt'; killed in action 2009. Composite also draws on general RAW Para-SF deep-cover archetypes for Pakistan operations.

inspiration_notes.major_mohit_sharma: Entered LeT as 'Iftikhar Bhatt', gathered actionable intel, was eventually exposed and killed. Awarded Ashok Chakra posthumously — India's highest peacetime gallantry award.
inspiration_notes.cover_parallel: Both Hamza/Jaskirat and Mohit Sharma used Muslim identity covers to embed inside Pakistani criminal/terror networks. Both operated without any official acknowledgement from Indian government.
